meta.name: story
meta.description: 网络小说工具箱主入口。根据用户需求自动路由到对应 skill，并可管理作者习惯、启动本地 Dashboard。触发方式：/story、$story、/story dashboard、/网文、「我想写小说」「记住我的写作习惯」「打开工作台」「检查更新」。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 进入你的网络小说创作工作台,自动调用对应工具并记住写作习惯
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你常写网络小说,想要一个统一的创作入口并让助手记住你的偏好
copy.tagline_en: Launch your web novel workspace, route to right tools, remember your habits.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you write web novels regularly and want a single entry point plus remembered preferences.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会作为网络小说工具箱的入口：根据你的请求把任务分派给对应的子技能（如写长篇、拆文、扫榜、去 AI 味、审稿、封面等），还能管理作者写作习惯、启动本地工作台、检查工具箱版本更新。
howto.when: 当你输入 /story、/网文，或说出「我想写小说」等请求时触发；请求不明确时也会接管并询问你想做什么。

say.text: 记住我的写作习惯：我习惯每天晚上写三千字
say.note: 会写入作者记忆，保留你的原话和适用范围。
会在本地启动 Dashboard，并把访问地址返回给你。

howto.what_en: Claude acts as the router of a web-novel toolbox: it dispatches requests to matching sub-skills (long/short writing, analysis, ranking, de-AI, review, cover), manages author preferences, launches a local dashboard, and checks for updates.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you type /story, /网文, or say something like 「我想写小说」; it also takes over when a request is ambiguous and asks what you want to do.

say_en.text: I want to write a long-form novel
say_en.note: Routes to long-form writing; prompts /story-setup if not initialized.

say_en.text: Remember my writing habit: I usually write 3,000 words every night
say_en.note: Saves it to author memory with your original wording.
Starts the local Dashboard and returns the access URL.
